query.statement: SELECT ITEM_ID, DELIVERY_ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PLANNED_QTY, ACTUAL_QTY, LOT_ID FROM SHP_DELIVERY_ITEM WHERE DELIVERY_ORDER_ID = @orderId ORDER BY CREATED_AT
SELECT HISTORY_ID, DELIVERY_ORDER_ID, SHIPPED_AT, SHIPPED_QTY, SHIPPED_BY, CARRIER, TRACKING_NO FROM SHP_SHIPMENT_HISTORY WHERE DELIVERY_ORDER_ID = @orderId ORDER BY SHIPPED_AT DESC
SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM SHP_DELIVERY_ORDER WHERE (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) AND (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) GROUP BY STATUS ORDER BY STATUS
